In [[mathematics]], a '''Rajchman measure''', studied by {{harvs|txt|last=Rajchman|authorlink=Aleksander Rajchman|year=1928}},  is a regular [[Borel measure]] on a [[locally compact group]] such as the circle, whose [[Fourier transform]] vanishes at infinity.
